definition_english: Designating regular departmental personnel or establishment posts maintained continuously throughout the year rather than engaged seasonally or intermittently.
definition_hindi: मौसमी या आंतरायिक रूप से नियुक्त किए जाने के बजाय पूरे वर्ष निरंतर बनाए रखे जाने वाले नियमित विभागीय कार्मिकों अथवा स्थापना पदों का विशेषण।

hindi_equivalents_etymology.चिरस्थायी: Sanskrit tatsama compound चिर + स्थायी (cira + sthāyī, 'long-lasting + standing/enduring'), attested in Hindwi
hindi_equivalents_etymology.स्थायी: Sanskrit tatsama adjective स्थायी (sthāyī, 'standing, permanent'), attested in Shabdkosh

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Attested in community-transcribed administrative phrasebooks (Hindi Wiktionary Saral Prashasanik Vakya Kosh: वन विभाग में वन रक्षक चिरस्थायी स्टाफ होता है)
Directly attested in Hindi Wiktionary Saral Prashasanik Vakya Kosh; English headword 'perennial staff' is also indexed in MHA Prashasnik Sabdawali PDF
Attested in Shabdkosh; denotes statutory permanence ('permanent'), whereas चिरस्थायी captures continuous year-round retention without necessarily implying statutory tenure

syntactic_patterns: attributive adjective before personnel or establishment nouns (perennial staff)

hindi.noun_type: Not applicable (head noun स्टाफ is पुल्लिंग जातिवाचक संज्ञा)
hindi.gender: Invariable (अविकारी) as adjective; head noun स्टाफ is masculine (पुल्लिंग)
hindi.case: Invariable across direct and oblique cases
hindi.adjective_agreement: Invariable (अविकारी); head noun स्टाफ governs masculine singular verb agreement (वन रक्षक चिरस्थायी स्टाफ होता है)
syntactic_patterns: attributive pre-nominal modifier before administrative personnel nouns (चिरस्थायी स्टाफ)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Public administration and government office correspondence
cultural_nuances: In Indian administrative usage, चिरस्थायी स्टाफ contrasts year-round regular departmental staff with seasonal or temporary field engagements without conflating with statutory permanent tenure (स्थायी पद).
usage_restrictions: Do not substitute सदानीरा (hydrology, S2), बहुवर्षी (botany, S1), or सदाबहार (evergreen) in administrative staffing contexts.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English perennial modifies collective or plural personnel nouns attributively (perennial staff). Hindi चिरस्थायी is a morphologically invariable tatsama adjective (अविकारी विशेषण) preceding the masculine noun स्टाफ, which controls masculine singular copular agreement (होता है) and takes postpositions.
linguistic_analysis.semantic_nuance: चिरस्थायी ('enduring for a long time') captures continuous year-round operational staffing more accurately than स्थायी ('permanent'), which denotes formal service-rule permanency.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Differentiates year-round regular establishment personnel from seasonal, ad-hoc, or intermittent staff in government departments.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Restricted strictly to public administration and personnel establishment (S4); distinct from plant biology (S1), hydrology (S2), general socioeconomic persistence (S3), and philosophy/education (S5).

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both denote continuity of service beyond brief or seasonal appointments.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चिरस्थायी indicates continuous year-round operation or long-term retention (attested specifically for perennial staff), whereas स्थायी corresponds to statutory 'permanent' status in service rules.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Moderate in general office prose; prefer चिरस्थायी when translating 'perennial staff' specifically.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both express year-round continuity across all twelve months.
pairwise_comparison.difference: चिरस्थायी belongs to formal official and administrative register, whereas बारहमासी carries agricultural, horticultural, and hydrological associations.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Low in official government correspondence; prefer चिरस्थायी.
